sources.title: Introducing the First AMD 1B Language Models: AMD OLMo
sources.snippet: AMD is releasing its first open source 1B language model, advancing accessible AI with high-performance AMD Instinct™ GPUs and Ryzen™ AI PCs.

sources.title: AMD-OLMo-1B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AMD-OLMo AMD-OLMo are a series of 1B language models trained from scratch by AMD on AMD Instinct™ MI250 GPUs. The training code used is based on OLMo. We release the pre-trained model, supervised fine-tuned model, and DPO aligned model as follows: AMD-OLMo-1B: Pre-trained on a subset of Dolma v1.7 that consists of 1.3 trillion tokens.

sources.title: Introducing the First AMD 1B Language Models: AMD OLMo
sources.snippet: The language model was also deployed onto AMD Ryzen AI PCs that can potentially help enable a diverse set of edge use cases. Open sourcing the data, weights, training recipes and code is primarily aimed at helping developers to reproduce as well as innovate further on top.

sources.title: OLMo 1B - open source | LLM Reference
sources.snippet: AMD OLMo 1B is a fully open-source large language model with 1 billion parameters, designed for advanced reasoning, instruction-following, and chat capabilities. Utilizing a decoder-only transformer architecture, it is trained on a 1.3 trillion-token subset of the Dolma v1.7 dataset, achieving a remarkable training throughput of 12,200 tokens per second per GPU.
